text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Every day is buono!
Big and delicious is the way to be♪
I'm Hishi Akebono~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today, as a special guest, my Trainer
has come to lend a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We train together every single day.
They're a truly wonderful Trainer!
choice_data_list: I-I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Bono-chan's Trainer!?"
"It's her Trainer!" "The Trainer!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chat streams past rapidly,
and colorful carrot stamps sent by viewers
to cheer her on dance across the screen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today I'll be sharing the requested
big and buono recipe that's perfect
for your Christmas parties~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Umasta Live began
as naturally as ever. —Rewind to a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Could you give me a hand
with my Umastagram Live, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Umastagram has a live streaming feature, you see.
Anyone can do a live broadcast, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes I use it
to hold cooking classes and stuff~"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Usually, I handle it by myself, but since I'm cooking a ton of food this time, I was hoping for someone to taste-test, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'd really like to
introduce you as my Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want everyone to know
that I'm working hard on racing with this person!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And then, maybe even waaay more people
will come watch my races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember something
she said in the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see even more smiles on everyone's faces~
I want the stands to be packed and bursting with cozy warmth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —We've gotta fill up the stands way, way more, don't we~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that that's settled,
I'm gonna cook a whole bunch of food~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we want everyone to get as hyped as possible,
we've gotta make sure the stands are full of satisfied bellies too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It seems the idea is to host cooking classes that also serve as PR activities for that purpose."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty☆ Today on the menu, we've got Christmas chicken,
cream stew, and a leaf salad~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to rub the salt into the chicken thoroughly!
About 1g of salt per 100g of meat is a good rule of thumb.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "Why are you rubbing it in?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, rubbing in salt removes any gaminess and makes the meat's moisture level just right~

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I tried making that curry from the other day with my mom!
It was super buono~"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really~?
I'm so happy~, thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "Always so easy to understand, what a lifesaver~"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad~ If there's anything you
don't understand, feel free to ask me anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Skillfully cooking while properly responding to comments.
They seem to have built a wonderful relationship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt like I caught a glimpse of a whole new side to Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the cooking proceeded in a heartwarming atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the chicken's done.
Alright then, let's wrap things up soon~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's sprinkle parsley on the cream stew!
Though honestly, it's fine without it too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you don't want to get your hands dirty, wrap the chicken in foil.
It's totally fine without it too, though~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's pour the homemade dressing on the salad~♪
Though you know, it's totally buono without it too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And with that, it's all done~☆
Go ahead and dig in, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Looks so good!" "Trade with meee!"
"Trainer-san, you're so lucky~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the comments instantly erupted with excitement,
I couldn't help but feel bewildered—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see, I see. Sorry about that!
It's totally normal to feel a bit nervous~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then,
maybe I'll eat with you too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I'm just gonna eat like normal, as always.
Thanks for the food~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Hishi Akebono digging in across from me,
I take a sip of the stew—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A breathtakingly rich flavor spread across my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I swallowed, I craved the sweet-and-spicy chicken,
and as soon as I finished the chicken,
I found myself reaching for the refreshing salad—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I caught my breath, our eyes met.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Buono?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
You sure ate like a champ~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, that was a truly buono Christmas recipe
that'll totally captivate you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for watching, everyone~
Be sure to give it a try yourselves~!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"That was some incredible momentum~"
"You could really tell how delicious Buono's food is."
"Maybe I'll try making it too~"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text: "Trainer and Bono-chan make such a wonderful pair, don't they~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umastagram Live came to a close
amidst a flood of warm comments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, for some reason, the other day's food review went a bit viral—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, look, look~
My followers suddenly shot up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Eat! Marvel! Get absorbed!
Watching such textbook dining warms the heart."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, come on~.
Hehe, it's all thanks to you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her fanbase, which had already been growing from her hard work in races,
reached a fever pitch after this latest mini-viral moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This incident sparked hope that Hishi Akebono's races
would garner even more attention going forward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With this momentum, I'd like to aim to win over even more fans!
